description: A request for proposals: the requester asks bidders to bid on the payload.

domain.description: The market domain, such as compute.

payload.description: The requested thing, such as a compute.vm record.

submitBid.description: Where bidders submit bids: a DID service ref (did#serviceId) or an HTTP URL.

ingress.description: The requester's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.ingress.webRTC listen records: the transports a stream listener can use when submitBid names no reachable HTTP service.

policies.description: Policy records the bidder evaluates before it bids.
